question: Can fourteen original held-period SOXX NPORT-P reports plus the one late 2025-Sep amendment yield exact disclosed-equity concentration values and amendment differences, without market outcomes or look-ahead?
formula: For each original primary XML, require CIK 0001100663, series S000004354, class C000012084 and exact repPdDate from the independently qualified index. Select invstOrSec with assetCat=EC, payoffProfile=Long, units=NS, curCd=USD, issuerCat=CORP. Require 30 positive-value distinct-name rows, original pctVal equal to 100*valUSD/netAssets within 0.000001 percentage point, and no row deletion for placeholder CUSIP. Normalize each original EC valUSD by sum of all 30 EC valUSD; top5 is the largest five normalized weights and HHI is sum squared. Keep DE/STIV counts outside EC denominator.
amendment: Compare 2025-09-30 original NPORT-P accession 0002071691-25-007653 against its 2026-07-13 NPORT-P/A accession 0002071691-26-015796 using original EC security names, CUSIPs, balances, values and concentration. Preserve any differences; never substitute amended values before their filing date or override a later report period.
availability: Every report event enters a native Qlib event DatasetH only on the next actual session after SEC filing date. The event series records a later amendment separately; it is not yet a daily active-state map.
artifacts: Save full original member rows, report events, amendment comparison and DatasetH in a native Qlib Recorder; NAS archive and verify remote hash plus scoped restoration. Keep card root slim.
stop: Any original hash, source identity, pct/netAssets closure, 30-row, event clock, DatasetH/Recorder or NAS failure stops. Preserve failed evidence; a mechanical parse correction needs a new frozen repair. No held-market selection, fit or account.
